method: Real POST /api/search/stream requests through the application, iterative reruns after fixes, then independent official company and TED notice checks. No mocked company scans. Offline regression tests are separate.
passMeaning: At least one useful current construction opportunity with plausible trade, scale and geography independently checked. Approval does not certify bidder eligibility or every result as equally useful.
limitations: First result pages were reviewed; live company pagination was not independently exhausted.
Complete selection documents and latest national-portal amendments remain review items.
Very small contractors need better below-threshold discovery: DAREMA is excluded.
Collini is excluded for supplier-evidence recall and standalone qualification issues; NGE for relaunch/all-lots/urgent-deadline uncertainty.
The fictional sample workspace illustrates all three fit labels. Live labels are never manufactured to create a mix.
Decker is withheld after a later user rerun yielded only one review-only notice. Featured examples are Vitali, STRABAG and Heijmans; replay counts are not guarantees of future live output.
